41:   private final boolean isMiddleManager;
42: 
43:   @Inject
44:   public WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitor(
45:       Injector injector,
46:       @Self Set<NodeRole> nodeRoles
47:   )
48:   {
49:     this.nodeRoles = nodeRoles;
50:     this.isMiddleManager = nodeRoles.contains(NodeRole.MIDDLE_MANAGER);
51:     if (isMiddleManager) {
52:       this.statsProvider = injector.getInstance(WorkerTaskCountStatsProvider.class);
53:       this.indexerStatsProvider = null;
54:       this.workerCategory = statsProvider.getWorkerCategory();
55:       this.workerVersion = statsProvider.getWorkerVersion();
56:     } else {
57:       this.indexerStatsProvider = injector.getInstance(IndexerTaskCountStatsProvider.class);
58:       this.statsProvider = null;
59:       this.workerCategory = null;
60:       this.workerVersion = null;
61:     }
62:   }
63: 
64:   @Override
65:   public boolean doMonitor(ServiceEmitter emitter)
66:   {
67:     boolean emitMiddleManagerMetrics = false;
68:     int recognizedRoleCount = 0;
69:     for (NodeRole role : nodeRoles) {
70:       if (role != null) {
71:         if (NodeRole.MIDDLE_MANAGER.equals(role)) {
72:           emitMiddleManagerMetrics = true;
73:           recognizedRoleCount++;
74:         } else if (NodeRole.INDEXER.equals(role)) {
75:           recognizedRoleCount++;
76:         } else if (NodeRole.PEON.equals(role)) {
77:           recognizedRoleCount++;
78:         } else if (NodeRole.COORDINATOR.equals(role)) {
79:           recognizedRoleCount++;
80:         } else if (NodeRole.HISTORICAL.equals(role)) {
81:           recognizedRoleCount++;
82:         } else if (NodeRole.BROKER.equals(role)) {
83:           recognizedRoleCount++;
84:         } else if (NodeRole.OVERLORD.equals(role)) {
85:           recognizedRoleCount++;
86:         } else if (NodeRole.ROUTER.equals(role)) {
87:           recognizedRoleCount++;
88:         } else {
89:           String jsonName = role.getJsonName();
90:           if (jsonName != null) {
91:             if (NodeRole.MIDDLE_MANAGER.getJsonName().equals(jsonName)
92:                 && NodeRole.MIDDLE_MANAGER.toString().equals(role.toString())) {
93:               emitMiddleManagerMetrics = true;
94:               recognizedRoleCount++;
95:             } else if (NodeRole.INDEXER.getJsonName().equals(jsonName)
96:                 && NodeRole.INDEXER.toString().equals(role.toString())) {
97:               recognizedRoleCount++;
98:             } else {
99:               recognizedRoleCount++;
100:             }
101:           }
102:         }
103:       }
104:     }
105: 
106:     if ((isMiddleManager || emitMiddleManagerMetrics) && recognizedRoleCount > 0) {
107:       final String categoryDimension = workerCategory;
108:       final String versionDimension = workerVersion;
109:       final Long failedTaskCount = statsProvider.getWorkerFailedTaskCount();
110:       if (failedTaskCount != null) {
111:         final ServiceMetricEvent.Builder failedBuilder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
112:         failedBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.CATEGORY, categoryDimension);
113:         failedBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.WORKER_VERSION, versionDimension);
114:         emitter.emit(failedBuilder.setMetric("worker/task/failed/count", failedTaskCount));
115:       }
116:       final Long successfulTaskCount = statsProvider.getWorkerSuccessfulTaskCount();
117:       if (successfulTaskCount != null) {
118:         final ServiceMetricEvent.Builder successfulBuilder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
119:         successfulBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.CATEGORY, categoryDimension);
120:         successfulBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.WORKER_VERSION, versionDimension);
121:         emitter.emit(successfulBuilder.setMetric("worker/task/success/count", successfulTaskCount));
122:       }
123:       final Long idleTaskSlotCount = statsProvider.getWorkerIdleTaskSlotCount();
124:       if (idleTaskSlotCount != null) {
125:         final ServiceMetricEvent.Builder idleBuilder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
126:         idleBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.CATEGORY, categoryDimension);
127:         idleBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.WORKER_VERSION, versionDimension);
128:         emitter.emit(idleBuilder.setMetric("worker/taskSlot/idle/count", idleTaskSlotCount));
129:       }
130:       final Long totalTaskSlotCount = statsProvider.getWorkerTotalTaskSlotCount();
131:       if (totalTaskSlotCount != null) {
132:         final ServiceMetricEvent.Builder totalBuilder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
133:         totalBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.CATEGORY, categoryDimension);
134:         totalBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.WORKER_VERSION, versionDimension);
135:         emitter.emit(totalBuilder.setMetric("worker/taskSlot/total/count", totalTaskSlotCount));
136:       }
137:       final Long usedTaskSlotCount = statsProvider.getWorkerUsedTaskSlotCount();
138:       if (usedTaskSlotCount != null) {
139:         final ServiceMetricEvent.Builder usedBuilder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
140:         usedBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.CATEGORY, categoryDimension);
141:         usedBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.WORKER_VERSION, versionDimension);
142:         emitter.emit(usedBuilder.setMetric("worker/taskSlot/used/count", usedTaskSlotCount));
143:       }
144:     } else {
145:       final Map<String, Long> runningTasks = indexerStatsProvider.getWorkerRunningTasks();
146:       for (Map.Entry<String, Long> runningEntry : runningTasks.entrySet()) {
147:         final Long runningCount = runningEntry.getValue();
148:         if (runningCount != null) {
149:           final ServiceMetricEvent.Builder runningBuilder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
150:           runningBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.DATASOURCE, runningEntry.getKey());
151:           emitter.emit(runningBuilder.setMetric("worker/task/running/count", runningCount));
152:         }
153:       }
154:       final Map<String, Long> assignedTasks = indexerStatsProvider.getWorkerAssignedTasks();
155:       for (Map.Entry<String, Long> assignedEntry : assignedTasks.entrySet()) {
156:         final Long assignedCount = assignedEntry.getValue();
157:         if (assignedCount != null) {
158:           final ServiceMetricEvent.Builder assignedBuilder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
159:           assignedBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.DATASOURCE, assignedEntry.getKey());
160:           emitter.emit(assignedBuilder.setMetric("worker/task/assigned/count", assignedCount));
161:         }
162:       }
163:       final Map<String, Long> completedTasks = indexerStatsProvider.getWorkerCompletedTasks();
164:       for (Map.Entry<String, Long> completedEntry : completedTasks.entrySet()) {
165:         final Long completedCount = completedEntry.getValue();
166:         if (completedCount != null) {
167:           final ServiceMetricEvent.Builder completedBuilder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
168:           completedBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.DATASOURCE, completedEntry.getKey());
169:           emitter.emit(completedBuilder.setMetric("worker/task/completed/count", completedCount));
170:         }
171:       }
172:       final Map<String, Long> failedTasks = indexerStatsProvider.getWorkerFailedTasks();
173:       for (Map.Entry<String, Long> failedEntry : failedTasks.entrySet()) {
174:         final Long failedCount = failedEntry.getValue();
175:         if (failedCount != null) {
176:           final ServiceMetricEvent.Builder failedBuilder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
177:           failedBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.DATASOURCE, failedEntry.getKey());
178:           emitter.emit(failedBuilder.setMetric("worker/task/failed/count", failedCount));
179:         }
180:       }
181:       final Map<String, Long> successfulTasks = indexerStatsProvider.getWorkerSuccessfulTasks();
182:       for (Map.Entry<String, Long> successfulEntry : successfulTasks.entrySet()) {
183:         final Long successfulCount = successfulEntry.getValue();
184:         if (successfulCount != null) {
185:           final ServiceMetricEvent.Builder successfulBuilder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
186:           successfulBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.DATASOURCE, successfulEntry.getKey());
187:           emitter.emit(successfulBuilder.setMetric("worker/task/success/count", successfulCount));
188:         }
189:       }
190:     }
191:     return true;
192:   }

196:     for (Map.Entry<String, Long> dataSourceTaskCount : dataSourceTaskMap.entrySet()) {
197:       if (dataSourceTaskCount.getValue() != null) {
198:         ServiceMetricEvent.Builder builder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
199:         builder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.DATASOURCE, dataSourceTaskCount.getKey());
200:         emitter.emit(builder.setMetric(metricName, dataSourceTaskCount.getValue()));
201:       }
202:     }
203:   }
204: }

part.text:
All 4 tests in `WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitorTest` pass, including the Peon case.

Fix summary (server/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/server/metrics/WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitor.java):
- The constructor now uses `injector.getExistingBinding(...)` to check whether `IndexerTaskCountStatsProvider` is bound before fetching it. Only `CliIndexer` binds this provider (`CliIndexer.java:163`); Peons don't, which caused the Guice `CreationException` after PR #15991.
- In `doMonitor`, when no provider is bound (e.g. Peon nodes), the monitor returns early without emitting metrics instead of throwing an NPE — matching the behavior verified by `testMonitorWithPeon`.
